Reviewed all 19 supplier interfaces and all eight steps. Schur gives a division ring; algebraic endomorphisms are scalar by factorization over C; evaluation embeds rational functions at a nonscalar x. The inverses (x-a)^(-1) are independent by clearing denominators and evaluating the resulting polynomial. Evaluation at a cyclic nonzero vector is injective, contradicting countable spanning. The lexicographic ranks of finite independent layers explicitly avoid countable choice; finite bases can be padded, and r=0 PBW gives the singleton basis. Bibliography now correctly identifies Pavel Etingof, matching the online title page and Lemma 7.2. The reader corrected a genuinely misattributed source entry (J. Dixon at an Etingof URL); the mathematical proof is unchanged and the source correction is accepted as a nonfatal citation repair.

Finite freeness from CST supplies a finite module; determinant trick proves the extended kernel proper; AC supplies a maximal ideal, whose contraction equals the original maximal kernel. Its finite residue field is C, so evaluation at lambda yields chi_(lambda-rho). Affine maximal-ideal correspondence and C-linearity identify characters with kernels; the dot-orbit supplier proves both directions. Rank zero gives C and a singleton parameter space. AC is explicitly carried for HC/CST and maximal-ideal existence. Reader change defines the already intended dot action and quotient, with no strengthened theorem; accepted as audit enrichment.

Reviewed all twelve supplier interfaces, F3’s analytic derivations and all proof steps. The induced operator norm bounds the exponential by an everywhere convergent scalar series; entrywise power-series differentiation and the product rule give d/dt f(xi exp(-t ad_x))=-(D_x f)(xi exp(-t ad_x)). All iterates vanish at zero by graded-ideal stability, and the entire-function Taylor supplier has radius infinity. Absolute convergence and the binomial identity give the group law and inverse. Homogeneous components prove conicality even at t=0; I=U has empty variety and I=0 (including g=0) has all g*. Reader additions expand elementary analytic justifications without changing the claim, and are nonfatal audit enrichment rather than a new defect. Current bytes match post-reader.

Reviewed all twelve supplier interfaces, five facts and five steps. AC carries the antidominant and dot-orbit suppliers. For every n>=0, M(-n-2) has all nonzero distinct weights -n-2-2k and is simple; both modules have normalized Casimir value n(n+2)/2 and equal character. An equal annihilator would give a finite-dimensional action quotient from L(n) that surjects onto the cyclic simple Verma, contradicting its infinitely many independent weight vectors.
